resources.string: You can choose a language here and customize the appearance to your liking.

If you want score lookup data from the community, you can set up your API info here and change it later in Settings.
Arkiroku also works without the score lookup API.

To determine your platform name, platform ID, and API user ID, send the /tkls command and the /sessiontoken command to any bot running Phi-Plugin.

An API Token is also required to vote in chart tag polls. Send /setApiToken <customToken> to any Phi-Plugin bot to set it, then enter the token above. The token is only used to authenticate with the score lookup API; we never upload your sessionToken.
